title: QCode-Method skills-lock
description: Declares vendor skills a project has chosen to install beyond the framework's own bundled ones — recommended, not required, prerequisites. compass-check's leverage lens reads this to flag drift between what's declared and what's actually present under .claude/skills/; tech-planning's ADR bridge reads it to know whether the architecture skill's full rigor is available. Not validated by a library at runtime (zero dependencies) — this file is the documented contract. To compute a hash: `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('hex'))" .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.

lockVersion.description: The shape of this file itself. Current value: 1.

skills.description: Keyed by skill name (matches its directory under .claude/skills/).

required.description: False for every skill this framework ships as an optional recommendation (e.g. architecture) — a missing required:true entry is a real gap; a missing required:false one just means the team hasn't installed the optional skill yet.

reason.description: Why this skill is worth having — what it unlocks, what falls back to a lesser path without it.

path.description: Where the skill's SKILL.md lives (or would live), relative to the project root.

source.description: Where the team gets this skill from — a shared skill repo, a specific vendor, a URL. A `(to define)` gap until foundation settles it.

hash.description: Hex-encoded digest of the installed SKILL.md's exact bytes, recorded the moment it's installed. Null means not yet installed. compass-check re-hashes the live file and compares — a mismatch means the vendor skill drifted upstream since it was last recorded here.

hashAlgorithm.description: Which digest algorithm hash was computed with. sha256 unless a project has a reason to differ.

installedAt.description: ISO date the hash was last recorded. Null until installed.
